mentions.name: Raft consensus implementation in C++
mentions.description: A from-scratch implementation of the Raft consensus algorithm in C++ using raw TCP sockets. It includes a high-performance RPC client and server built to minimize network latency, and demonstrates event-driven I/O with epoll and event-loop architectures for asynchronous networking.
mentions.problem: Built as a learning exercise to hone systems programming skills and get more comfortable with distributed systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm implementing Raft consensus from scratch in C++ with raw TCP sockets. Right now I'm working on a high-performance RPC client and server to keep network latency to a minimum.
